Container.Name: parallex-lftp
Container.Overview: Dual-pane web file browser backed by lftp (FTP/FTPS/SFTP) with parallel segmented downloads (pget -n), a Site Manager, live transfer queue, single-user login, and encrypted-at-rest saved passwords. The LOCAL pane browses the mounted /data share.

Config.Name: Data (LOCAL pane)
Config.Description: The share the LOCAL pane browses; downloads land here and uploads are read from here.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Persistent state: saved sites, settings, web-UI account, encryption keyfile, SSH known_hosts.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User id the app runs as. 99 = Unraid's 'nobody', so downloaded files are editable over SMB.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group id the app runs as. 100 = Unraid's 'users'.

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: Permission mask for new files. 022 = owner-write only; 002 = group-writable; 000 = wide open (common on Unraid shares).

Config.Name: PARALLEX_SECRET
Config.Description: Optional but recommended: secret for encrypting saved site passwords. When set, the encryption key never touches the config share. Leave empty to use an auto-generated keyfile in /config instead.

Config.Name: AUTH_USERNAME
Config.Description: Optional: seed the single web-UI account at first start (only while no account exists). Leave empty to create the account in the browser on first visit.

Config.Name: AUTH_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Password for the seeded account (min 8 characters). Stored only as a hash.
